cases.prompt: Block privileged containers and pods with no resource limits from being admitted to our cluster.
assertions: Starts from Pod Security Standards, then adds a Kyverno ClusterPolicy for what PSA cannot express
Rolls out Audit with background:true before switching validationFailureAction to Enforce
Scopes to namespaces and excludes kube-system so cluster components are not blocked

cases.prompt: Our Kyverno admission policies have no tests and one silently stopped matching. How do we test policy as code?
assertions: Runs kyverno test with resource fixtures and conftest verify on Rego test rules, both in CI
Warns that an untested guardrail silently stops matching after a schema or API change
Keeps policies and their tuning filters in version control with an owner and a review date

cases.prompt: Should we use Kyverno or OPA Gatekeeper for our platform, and how do we handle workloads that legitimately need an exception?
assertions: Chooses between Kyverno and Gatekeeper on concrete criteria including mutation and Rego logic
Warns against running both engines for overlapping concerns
Requires every PolicyException to carry an owner, a reason, and an expiry enforced in CI
